extName.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions (max 75 chars)

extDescription.message: Auto delete cookies when you close a tab. Cookie cleaner with keep lists, partitioned cookie support and list import. No tracking.

finishSetupToStart.message: Finish setup in Settings to start

hintClean.message: Cookies and site data are deleted after you close the last tab of this site.

hintSession.message: Kept while the browser is open, deleted the next time the browser starts (if "Clean on browser start" is on).

hintKeep.message: Never cleaned automatically. Use for sites you want to stay logged in to.

setByRule.message: Set by the rule "$P1$" in Settings.

ruleStillApplies.message: The rule "$P1$" in Settings still applies to $P2$.

cleanFailed.message: Could not clean. Try again, or reload CrumbClear in chrome://extensions.

nothingToClean.message: Nothing to clean: no closed sites left behind.

removedForSite.message: Removed $P1$ for $P2$. Reload the page to see it logged out.

segAria.message: What happens to this site's cookies

noSite.message: This page has no site cookies to manage.

undone.message: Restored $P1$. These sites are kept until you open and close them again.

rateText.message: Is CrumbClear useful? A rating in the Chrome Web Store helps others find it.

optionsLead.message: Cookies and site data are deleted when you close the last tab of a site. Sites on your lists are left alone.

setupTitle.message: First, pick the sites you want to stay signed in to

setupDesc.message: Auto-clean is off until you finish. After that, cookies of every other site are deleted once you close its tabs. Google, Microsoft, Apple, GitHub and Okta sign-in are already on your Keep list. Moving from Cookie AutoDelete? Import your list below first.

setupEmpty.message: No other sites have cookies right now.

setupDone.message: Keep selected and turn on auto-clean

optAutoCleanDesc.message: Pause to keep everything until you turn it back on.

optDelayDesc.message: Time to reopen a tab before its cookies are gone. Several closed tabs are cleaned together.

optDomain.message: Clean when a tab moves to another site

optDomainDesc.message: Navigating away counts as closing the old site.

optSiteDataDesc.message: localStorage, IndexedDB, cache storage and service workers, not just cookies.

optStartupDesc.message: Removes leftovers from the last session, including "until restart" sites. When off, "until restart" sites are kept like Keep.

optBadgeDesc.message: Blue: kept. Amber: kept until restart. Teal: will be cleaned. Grey: auto-clean is paused.

listsEmpty.message: No sites yet. Add the ones you want to stay logged in to.

importHelp.message: Moving from Cookie AutoDelete? In its settings choose Export, then import that file here. Whitelist becomes Keep, greylist becomes Until restart. A plain text file with one domain per line also works.

logEmpty.message: Nothing cleaned yet. Close a tab and wait for the delay.

notDomain.message: That does not look like a domain. Try example.com or *.example.com.

listsFull.message: Your lists are full ($P1$ sites). Remove some first.

addedSuffix.message: Added $P1$. Note: this covers every site ending in .$P2$.

fileTooLarge.message: That file is too large to be a list of sites (limit 1 MB).

noSitesFound.message: No sites found in that file.

tooManyImport.message: Too many sites: your lists can hold $P1$. Nothing was imported.

tooManySetup.message: Too many sites: your lists can hold $P1$.
